name: An island not yet entered

date.label: The Burning Crusade patch 2.3 continuation; exact in-world date unknown

summary: Jaina chooses an aerial survey instead of a costly ground assault.
description: Jaina says Renn’s suspicion about Alcaz Island merits a survey, but a force large enough to fight through the island would overstrain Theramore’s defenses. She arranges an aerial inspection with Cassa Crimsonwing, an apprentice gryphon handler. The choice is cautious: gather knowledge before committing troops. From above the marsh, the island can be observed without pretending that its hidden defenders or their purpose are already understood.
